subject: Re: Align demo timing with Acme FY spend gate / PMO calendar
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Acme PMO <pmo@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed demo time — aligning with your planning cycle

Hi Lisa / PMO team,

Thanks again for the time on the discovery call yesterday. Per our conversation, we'd like to run a 45-minute demo focused on cost/latency tradeoffs and the rollout guardrails (canary, routing, private VPC).

Proposed slots next week (PST):
- Tue Apr 13, 11:00–11:45
- Wed Apr 14, 14:00–14:45
- Thu Apr 15, 09:00–09:45

I've attached a short agenda and an updated SOW/pricing snapshot; Aditya will be there to cover commercial questions and Monica will cover onboarding/CS flows. If any of these conflict with your FY planning or procurement milestones, please let us know — we can record the session and follow up after your spend gate.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-demo-agenda.md, SOW_v2.pdf, pricing_estimate.xlsx

-----Original Message-----
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Acme PMO <pmo@acme-corp.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 11:03:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed demo time — aligning with your planning cycle

Hi Kimberly —

Appreciate the follow-up and the materials. We need to hold off briefly: our FY budget reset is next week and the PMO is consolidating all vendor demos into a single review queue. Additionally, our CFO will be traveling Apr 12–18 which compresses approval windows. Procurement flagged any vendor demos that fall before the spend gate for potential reschedule.

Can you hold proposed sessions until we finish the gate review (we expect a decision by May 3)? If you can provide a short recorded walk-through we can circulate to stakeholders in the meantime, that would be helpful.

Lisa Chen
Program Manager, Strategic Initiatives
Acme Corporation

-----Original Message-----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 12:40:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposed demo time — aligning with your planning cycle

Looping you in — dealer's table: Acme wants to pause demos until after their FY spend gate (decision target May 3) and CFO travel is causing the tight window. Procurement is CC'd.

Thoughts: offer a short recorded demo + a live Q&A the week of May 10 as a provisional slot. Keeps momentum, shows flexibility, and avoids clogging PMO calendar. Also might offer a non-binding placeholder invite that can be canceled without penalty.

If Lauren agrees, I can propose language and send calendar placeholders. Monica — any objections from CS side on deferring live onboarding until after the gate?

-Aditya

-----Original Message-----
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 08:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed demo time — aligning with your planning cycle

Sounds reasonable. Two quick asks for the proposal:
1) Make the recorded demo concise (15–20 minutes) with clear chapters: capabilities, integration touchpoints, cost controls, SSO/KMS notes.
2) Include a non-committal placeholder for May 10–14 with a note: "subject to PMO approval after FY spend gate."

Also add a single-slide pricing summary that highlights commitment vs. pay-as-you-go economics — keeps procurement engaged without overwhelming them.

Thanks — I’ll review the text before it goes out.

-Lauren

-----Original Message-----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme-corp.com>, Acme PMO <pmo@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed demo time — aligning with your planning cycle

Hi Lisa —

Thanks for the context and the quick turnaround. We can absolutely do a short recorded walk-through (15 mins) and circulate. I’ve attached a one-slide pricing summary and the agenda.

If it helps, we can tentatively hold the week of May 10 (May 10–14) for a live session and mark it as "pending PMO sign-off" — we'll only send a confirmed invite after you give the green light. Would that work for your team?

Best,

Kimberly

-----Original Message-----
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Acme PMO <pmo@acme-corp.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:34:28 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed demo time — aligning with your planning cycle

Kimberly —

Thanks — the recorded demo and one-pager are perfect for the PMO packet. Please go ahead and share the recording link and the single-slide pricing summary. The PMO will review during the gate and we should have a direction by May 3.

Tentatively, May 11 (11:00–11:45 EST) looks like a good live slot for senior stakeholders — please hold that in your calendars as pending. Procurement is copied; they may reach out with standard vendor paperwork (NDA/Vendor Onboarding) while the PMO completes the review.

Lisa

If procurement needs the vendor questionnaire answered in the meantime, Aditya will coordinate. Monica will prepare an onboarding cost/effort note for post-approval planning.

Appreciate the clarity here — we’ll be ready to move quickly once you clear the gate.
